projects.name: Clarity Index
projects.nextAction: Build the X + LinkedIn news-pull extension that publishes to Clarity Index and auto-posts published links to X and LinkedIn with captioned images.
projects.context: Owner: Kousik. Active project. Current build: a browser extension that runs on a schedule, pulls the latest relevant project news from X (Twitter) and LinkedIn, refreshes/publishes those items on the Clarity Index platform, and posts the published links back out to the project's X and LinkedIn accounts with captioned photos. Distribution targets: X and LinkedIn only. Not Meta/Instagram.

tasks.title: Build a browser extension that polls X and LinkedIn for the latest Clarity Index-relevant news, publishes/refreshes those items on the Clarity Index platform, then posts each published link to the project's X and LinkedIn accounts with a captioned photo.
tasks.notes: Pipeline of three stages: (1) periodic news pull from X/Twitter and LinkedIn, (2) publish + refresh on Clarity Index platform, (3) auto-share published link to X and LinkedIn with a captioned image. Sources are X and LinkedIn (not Meta/Instagram). Open inputs: definition of "relevant" project news, Clarity Index publish endpoint/API, and API access for posting.
